comparison.note: Paired scene observations; application present timing, not scanout or input latency.

scope.game_frames: Source 2 application swap intervals; not physical scanout or input latency
scope.gpu: Whole NVIDIA device via NVML at 4 Hz, with the driver averaging window
scope.cpu: CS2 process CPU, expressed as percent of one core
scope.control: Prototype surfaces removed; existing mpvpaper stopped, its retained textures remain
scope.timedemo: One rendered frame per demo tick; world playback accelerates at higher FPS
scope.warmup: One full replay excluded, then first 1024 ticks excluded in each measured run
scope.clock: Coarse clock bridge from buffered CSV flushes; not suitable for attributing an individual hitch
scope.focus: CS2 replay keeps rendering when unfocused (engine_no_focus_sleep=0); focus state is retained in raw observations.

limitations: A local fixed-camera replay is not a live multiplayer match.
Short runs and small low-percentile sample counts need repeated observations.
External applications and compositor workload can still vary.
GPU-only bottleneck or a renderer winner cannot be inferred from average utilization.
Video config, FPS cap and VSync are submitted settings; only dimensions and the subset in engine_settings are independently reported by Source 2.

clock_bridge.note: Buffered file clock estimate; coarse GPU trends only.
